Competitive Analysis Dashboard

Designing actionable insights under startup constraints
Role: Sole Product Designer
Company: Worthix (AI SaaS Startup)
Collaborators: Lara Baldez Duque Ribeiro, Worthix Team
Timeline: October 2025
Tools: Figma, Claude, Cursor, GitHub

Background

Worthix Hub is an AI-powered platform that scrapes and analyzes online reviews to help companies understand customer sentiment. The platform generates "Keep Doing" and "Do Better" summaries, but clients struggled to act on these insights without visual comparison tools. The challenge: Clients requested in-app data visualization capabilities to benchmark against competitors and industry trends, rather than exporting data to external tools like PowerBI.

The Problem

The initial prototype provided delivered insights but lacked: No visual comparison - Clients couldn't see performance relative to competitors or industry averages Poor information hierarchy - All data treated equally, making it difficult to identify priorities Limited actionability - Users received analysis without clear next steps
